about: Public-notice channels per operator or agency: pages, sites, feeds, lists and accounts through which the public is told of sewage discharges, by law, permit or voluntarily. Read by pipeline/ingest/notification_pages.py (schema and validator there; test tests/test_notice_channels.py).

channels.name: Clean Ocean Access
channels.note: Clean Ocean Access monitoring. Voluntary; unreachable in the research. https://www.cleanoceanaccess.org answered 522 to the project user agent on 2026-11-03. (research/ri/report.md §2.6)

channels.name: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (ECHO)
channels.note: EPA ECHO sewer overflow and bypass event records (NPDES eReporting). Voluntary publication by EPA: operators must report noncompliance to the permitting authority within 24 hours (40 CFR 122.41(l)(6)); EPA publishes the electronic reports. . Covers every operator in the state. (research/federal/report.md)

channels.name: Narragansett Bay Commission - Bucklin Point WWTF and associated CSOs
channels.legal_basis: RIPDES permit RI0100072 (2017): 'develop a system to provide web-based notification to the public on CSO occurrences'
channels.note: Narragansett Bay Commission CSO Alarm Map and its API. Overflows stay visible up to 48 hours; no archive, so the site polls. No email, text or social channel. (research/ri/report.md §2.1, §2.3)

channels.name: Narragansett Bay Commission
channels.note: NBC river and bay bacteria (annual PDFs). Voluntary; annual PDFs through 2022. (research/ri/report.md §2.3)

channels.name: Narragansett Bay Commission - Field's Point WWTF and associated CSOs
channels.legal_basis: RIPDES permit RI0100315 (2017): 'develop a system to provide web-based notification to the public on CSO occurrences'
channels.note: Narragansett Bay Commission CSO Alarm Map and its API. Overflows stay visible up to 48 hours; no archive, so the site polls. No email, text or social channel. (research/ri/report.md §2.1, §2.3)

channels.name: City of Newport Utilities - Water Pollution Control (WPCF and two CSO treatment facilities)
channels.note: Newport Harbor water quality station (WQDataLive). Voluntary sensor display; unreachable in the research. https://www.wqdatalive.com/public/2461 answered connection to the project user agent on 2026-11-03. (research/ri/report.md §6)

channels.name: City of Newport Utilities - Water Pollution Control (WPCF and two CSO treatment facilities)
channels.note: Newport red flags at the CSO facilities and the Harbormaster's Building, with the 'Summary of CSO Events since 2001' PDF. Basis not cited in the research (the city is under a consent decree); flags stay up until 24 hours after the overflow stops. URL as recorded in the source registry. (research/ri/report.md §2.4)

channels.name: Rhode Island sewer system operators
channels.note: Other RI plants and collection systems: own public notice. Voluntary only: Rhode Island has no law requiring public notice of overflows; none of these systems offers one. Their reports reach the public through EPA ECHO and RIDEM shellfish closures. Covers: ri-bristol-wwtf, ri-burrillville-wwtf, ri-central-falls-collection, ri-pawtucket-collection, ri-cranston-wpcf, ri-zambarano-wwcs, ri-east-greenwich-wwtf, ri-east-providence-wpcf, ri-jamestown-wwtf, ri-nbc-member-towns-collection, ri-new-shoreham-wpcf, ri-north-kingstown-collection, ri-quonset-wwtf, ri-scarborough-wwtf, ri-smithfield-wwtp, ri-south-kingstown-wwtf, ri-middletown-collection, ri-warren-wwtf, ri-warwick-wwtf, ri-west-warwick-wwtf, ri-westerly-wwtf, ri-woonsocket-wwtf. (research/ri/report.md §2.4, §3)

channels.name: News media (Rhode Island)
channels.note: No URL known (not searched): Press (ecoRI, WPRI, Rhode Island Current). Voluntary and ad hoc. Examples: https://ecori.org/when-sewage-spills-into-waterways-theres-no-state-requirement-to-alert-public/. (research/ri/report.md §2.1, §2.7)

channels.name: Rhode Island DEM
channels.note: RIDEM press releases (RSS). Voluntary; big SSOs appear only here, usually with a shellfish closure; Cloudflare blocks servers. (research/ri/report.md §2.2)

channels.name: Rhode Island DEM
channels.legal_basis: R.I. Gen. Laws § 20-8.1-3: annual newspaper notice of polluted areas; licensees must call a dedicated telephone line before taking shellfish from conditionally approved waters
channels.note: RIDEM shellfish closures: 24-hour hotline 401-222-2900 and status page. The only legal public channel that reaches sewage releases in RI (closures after spills); dem.ri.gov sits behind a Cloudflare challenge. Covers every operator in the state. (research/ri/report.md §2.1-2.2)

channels.name: Rhode Island DEM
channels.note: RIDEM shellfish closure email alerts (Constant Contact). Voluntary list covering 'emergency closures (harmful alga blooms, sewage releases, etc)'. https://lp.constantcontactpages.com/sl/vXQmyK9 answered 403 to the project user agent on 2026-11-03. Sign-up status: captcha (docs/subscriptions.md). (research/ri/report.md §2.2)

channels.name: Rhode Island Department of Health
channels.legal_basis: 216-RICR-50-10-3 § 3.4.11(B): beach closure advisories at the Beach Action Value, at RIDOH's discretion
channels.note: RIDOH beach closure list (Google Sheet behind health.ri.gov/beaches). Causes are not stated. (research/ri/report.md §2.5)

channels.name: Rhode Island Department of Health
channels.note: RIDOH beach advisory feed and beach pages. Voluntary publication of the closures in the sheet, timed to the minute; browser only. (research/ri/report.md §2.5)

channels.name: Rhode Island Department of Health
channels.note: RIDOH press releases (RSS), contact advisories after spills. Voluntary; RIDOH 'leads on notifying the public through health advisories' (DEM, ecoRI 2026-06-18). (research/ri/report.md §2.2, §2.5)

channels.name: Rhode Island Department of Health
channels.note: RIDOH volunteer beach observations sheet (Save The Bay, URI Watershed Watch). Voluntary; 'RIDOH cannot endorse/verify specific observations.'. (research/ri/report.md §2.5)

channels.name: Salt Ponds Coalition
channels.note: Salt Ponds Coalition bacteria report. Voluntary annual PDF. (research/ri/report.md §2.6)

channels.name: Save The Bay
channels.note: Save The Bay water quality posts. Voluntary; data via the RIDOH sheet. (research/ri/report.md §2.6)

channels.name: Surfrider Foundation
channels.note: Surfrider Blue Water Task Force, Rhode Island. Voluntary; data behind a GraphQL widget (terms to check). (research/ri/report.md §2.6)

channels.name: Swim Drink Fish
channels.note: Swim Guide listings for Rhode Island. Voluntary; 'does not actively update Rhode Island beaches.'. (research/ri/report.md §2.6)
channels.barrier_review: an app only (Swim Guide): no web page of its own, but no login wall either

channels.name: URI Watershed Watch
channels.note: URI Watershed Watch. Voluntary; bacteria in PDFs only. (research/ri/report.md §2.6)

channels.name: Woonasquatucket River Watershed Council
channels.note: Woonasquatucket River Watershed Council monitoring. Voluntary; unreachable in the research. https://wrwc.org/watershed-water-quality-monitoring/ answered connection to the project user agent on 2026-11-03. (research/ri/report.md §2.6)
